# dewfpga

> Command-line toolchain that builds SystemVerilog for the Digilent Basys3 (XC7A35T) on an Apple Silicon Mac without Vivado: `dewfpga sim`, `dewfpga bit`, `dewfpga flash`. Every failure is one line in one format, `file:line: ERROR [code]: message`, and each code has a page below.

Generated by docs/llms-build.py from README.md, docs/manual-setup.md and docs/errors.md. Commands exist only as listed in the README's Commands section; `sim`, `bit`, `check` and `flash` accept `--json` for one machine-readable result object. Board: Basys3 only. Platform: macOS arm64 only.

## Errors

- [oss-cad-suite-no-nextpnr-xilinx](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/oss-cad-suite-no-nextpnr-xilinx/): YosysHQ's bundle ships nextpnr for ice40, ecp5, nexus and Gowin. Not Xilinx.
- [externally-managed-environment](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/externally-managed-environment/): PEP 668. Homebrew's Python refuses a plain pip install. The chain needs a venv.
- [fopenmp](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/fopenmp/): nextpnr's default build asks Apple's clang for OpenMP, which it does not have.
- [no-chipdb](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/no-chipdb/): There is no prebuilt chipdb. It is generated per device from the prjxray data.
- [yaml-cpp-not-built](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/yaml-cpp-not-built/): prjxray was cloned without --recursive, so its submodules are empty.
- [cmake-policy-version-minimum](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/cmake-policy-version-minimum/): prjxray is written for an older CMake. CMake 4 refuses it without a policy flag.
- [missing-separator](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/missing-separator/): The recipe lines lost their Tab characters when you copied them.
- [no-iostandard-property](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/no-iostandard-property/): A port in your design has no pin in the .xdc file. nextpnr names the wrong port.
- [port-neither-input-nor-output](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/port-neither-input-nor-output/): The course's seven-segment module has a broken port line. Vivado accepts it, Yosys does not.
- [board-not-found](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/board-not-found/): The Mac does not see the Basys3 on the USB bus: power switch, PROG port, a charge-only cable, the adapter, or the JP2 jumper.
- [unknown-command](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/unknown-command/): The word after dewfpga is not one of its commands (install, check, new, sim, bit, flash, clean, uninstall).
- [unknown-option](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/unknown-option/): A word starting with - after the command, or an argument after install: the commands take a module or file name at most, install takes nothing.
- [no-source-file](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/no-source-file/): The current folder holds no .sv or .v file; dewfpga works on the files in the folder you run it in.
- [run-inside-the-folder](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/run-inside-the-folder/): The argument holds a slash: the CLI takes a module or a file name in the current folder, not a path.
- [file-name-with-space](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/file-name-with-space/): A .sv, .v or .xdc file name with a space in it; yosys, iverilog and nextpnr take file lists split at spaces.
- [path-with-space](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/path-with-space/): The CLI's own folder or FPGA_HOME has a space in its path; the build scripts hand those paths to make and the tools unquoted.
- [utf8-bom](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/utf8-bom/): The file starts with the three invisible bytes EF BB BF that Notepad and some editors write; yosys reads them as a token it does not know.
- [folder-exists](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/folder-exists/): The folder dewfpga new was told to create is already there; it never overwrites a design.
- [no-xdc-file](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/no-xdc-file/): The folder has the design but no .xdc; the pin file says which pin of the Basys3 each port goes to, and without it nothing can be placed.
- [two-xdc-files](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/two-xdc-files/): Several .xdc files in the folder and none named after the top module; the CLI does not guess which one is the pin file.
- [no-testbench](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/no-testbench/): No module without ports instantiates the top module, so there is nothing to simulate it with.
- [no-top-module](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/no-top-module/): The source scan ended without a top module and without a reason; naming the module on the command line settles it.
- [toolchain-not-installed](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/toolchain-not-installed/): nextpnr-xilinx, the chip database or another tool is not under FPGA_HOME; the build needs all of them.
- [yosys-slang-does-not-load](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/yosys-slang-does-not-load/): The second reader is a plugin compiled against one yosys; after brew upgrade yosys it no longer loads.
- [fpga-home-unsafe](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/fpga-home-unsafe/): FPGA_HOME points at your home folder or /; uninstall deletes what install.sh put under FPGA_HOME and will not touch those.
- [no-install-found](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/no-install-found/): Not an error: uninstall found none of the six entries install.sh writes under FPGA_HOME.
- [two-tops](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/two-tops/): Two or more design modules that nothing instantiates; the CLI does not pick one by file name (Lab 4 folders name the file after the wrong one).
- [top-is-a-testbench](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/top-is-a-testbench/): The module named on the command line has no ports, so it is a testbench; a bitstream needs a design with ports.
- [no-such-module](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/no-such-module/): The name on the command line is neither a module nor a file of this folder.
- [no-design-module](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/no-design-module/): Every module in the folder has no ports; there is nothing to build.
- [module-defined-twice](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/module-defined-twice/): Two files in the folder declare the same module; the tools would take the last one read, so a backup could be built instead of the design.
- [finish-in-design](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/finish-in-design/): A $finish or $stop inside a module with ports; there is no hardware for it, and yosys stops on it where Vivado drops it.
- [decl-init-reads-signal](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/decl-init-reads-signal/): `logic [3:0] sum = sw[3:0] + sw[7:4];` sets a power-up value from a signal; it is not a continuous assignment, and the board would show the value from time 0 forever.
- [unnamed-instance](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/unnamed-instance/): `inv(sw[0], led[0]);`, an instance without a name: Vivado accepts it, the standard and yosys do not, so the CLI names it u_inv in your file and says so.
- [vivado-netlist-in-folder](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/vivado-netlist-in-folder/): A .v file whose header says it is a Vivado post-synthesis simulation netlist sits next to the sources; it is not a design and yosys cannot read it.
- [port-without-pin](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/port-without-pin/): A port of the top module has no PACKAGE_PIN line in the XDC: the line is commented out, the index is missing, the name differs, or the port has a shape this check does not read yet ([0:0], [4:1]).
- [no-such-pin](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/no-such-pin/): A PACKAGE_PIN in the XDC names a pin the chip does not have: a typo, a pin of another board, a power pin, or a pin written in small letters (w5).
- [pin-used-twice](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/pin-used-twice/): Two ports of the design have the same PACKAGE_PIN in the XDC: a copied line whose pin was not changed.
- [xdc-get-ports-form](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/xdc-get-ports-form/): A get_ports with a wildcard, a list of several ports or an option (-regexp, -filter): Vivado expands those, this check reads one full port name per line.
- [xdc-port-case](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/xdc-port-case/): An XDC line names a port that differs from the design's only in case; names are case-sensitive, so the line pins nothing.
- [iverilog-refused](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/iverilog-refused/): iverilog stopped with an error; its own lines are above, and this line names the first of them.
- [sim-from-build](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/sim-from-build/): Not an error: iverilog refused a construct in the design, so the testbench ran against the design as the build elaborates it, read by the reader the note names.
- [sim-from-build-parameters](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/sim-from-build-parameters/): iverilog refused the design and the testbench sets the top module's parameters; the simulation of the design as the build reads it cannot apply them, so it stops instead of testing another design.
- [sim-timeout](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/sim-timeout/): The testbench never called $finish, or needs longer than the timeout; the CLI killed the simulator.
- [sim-exit](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/sim-exit/): vvp ended with a non-zero exit: a $fatal in the testbench, or a run that ended without $finish.
- [testbench-error](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/testbench-error/): The simulation ran to $finish, and the testbench printed ERROR: lines with $error: a check failed.
- [packed-typedef-2d](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/packed-typedef-2d/): A typedef of a two-dimensional packed array used to declare a parameter or a net; yosys flattens the type and every row index picks one bit.
- [ref-argument](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/ref-argument/): A function or task argument passed by reference; yosys' reader stops on it and yosys-slang builds the call as nothing.
- [package-file-not-given](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/package-file-not-given/): The package lives in its own file, and the CLI hands the tools only the files that hold a module, so the package is not read.
- [package-not-found](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/package-not-found/): An import or pkg::NAME names a package no file in the folder declares.
- [isunknown-in-design](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/isunknown-in-design/): $isunknown in synthesizable code; a chip has no x, and yosys folds the call to a constant that differs from the simulation.
- [latch](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/latch/): A combinational block leaves a signal unassigned on some path, so it has to remember its value: a latch, built as Vivado builds it, with the same warning.
- [latch-loop](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/latch-loop/): A latch the reader turned into a combinational loop instead of a latch cell; the loop does not behave like the simulation, so the build stops.
- [async-reset-nonconst](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/async-reset-nonconst/): In an always_ff with an asynchronous reset, the reset branch loads a register from a signal, or a signal is written outside the reset if/else; a flip-flop can only reset to a constant.
- [async-reset-polarity](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/async-reset-polarity/): The sensitivity list names one edge of the reset and the first if tests the other level, so the reset edge lands in the else branch, which loads a signal.
- [async-reset-not-alone](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/async-reset-not-alone/): The block has a clock and an asynchronous reset in its sensitivity list, but the first if tests the reset ORed with another signal.
- [dual-edge](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/dual-edge/): One always block clocked on posedge and negedge of the same clock; the chip's flip-flops have one clock edge.
- [initial-from-signal](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/initial-from-signal/): An initial block, or a declaration, sets a register's start value from a signal; power-up values are constants.
- [two-always-drivers](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/two-always-drivers/): The same register is assigned in two always blocks; yosys resolves the conflict silently, Vivado refuses it.
- [always-and-assign](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/always-and-assign/): A signal assigned both in an always block and with assign; two drivers on one wire.
- [two-assign-drivers](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/two-assign-drivers/): A signal with two assign lines; two drivers on one wire.
- [multiple-drivers](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/multiple-drivers/): A signal written from more than one place that the checker could not sort into always blocks and assigns; two drivers on one wire.
- [undeclared-name](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/undeclared-name/): A name used but never declared; yosys' reader makes an implicit 1-bit wire with no driver, so the design would be built without it.
- [hierarchical-name](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/hierarchical-name/): A signal reached through an instance name (u_cnt.count); yosys' own reader does not resolve it. With yosys-slang installed the design builds, with the read-with-slang note.
- [interface-member](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/interface-member/): A member of an interface instance read in the module that declares the instance; yosys' own reader makes an undriven wire of it. With yosys-slang installed the design builds.
- [module-not-found](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/module-not-found/): An instance of a module no file in the folder declares.
- [enum-method-next-prev](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/enum-method-next-prev/): The enum methods next() and prev(); neither reader builds them, Vivado does.
- [slang-refused](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/slang-refused/): Both readers refused the code; yosys' own line is printed first, then yosys-slang's error with its caret.
- [slang-unimplemented](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/slang-unimplemented/): yosys-slang stops on a construct it has no implementation for, without a line; the code line dump above it shows the construct.
- [yosys-crashed](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/yosys-crashed/): yosys died with a signal instead of an error message; a real literal in a parameter is the known cause, and the line that holds one is named.
- [second-reader-missing](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/second-reader-missing/): The code needs the second reader, and it is not built; the error above it may go away with it.
- [read-with-slang](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/read-with-slang/): Not an error: yosys' own reader refused the code, yosys-slang read it, and synthesis went on as usual.
- [v-is-verilog-2005](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/v-is-verilog-2005/): A .v file that holds SystemVerilog; both readers, like Vivado, read .v as Verilog-2005, so logic and always_ff are syntax errors there.
- [no-create-clock](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/no-create-clock/): Not an error: the XDC has no create_clock line, so every clock is checked at the board's 100 MHz.
- [internal-tristate](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/internal-tristate/): A z driven onto an internal signal or a submodule port; the chip's tri-state buffers sit on pins only, and yosys keeps the buffer as a cell nextpnr cannot place.
- [tristate-to-logic](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/tristate-to-logic/): Two z drivers on one internal bus in one module; yosys builds them as logic, as Vivado does, so the board never shows the z or x the simulation shows.
- [wired-net](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/wired-net/): A wor or wand net with several drivers; yosys keeps the wired resolution as a $and/$or cell nextpnr cannot place.
- [power-operator](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/power-operator/): The ** operator with a variable base; yosys builds only constant powers and 2 ** n.
- [empty-module](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/empty-module/): An instance of a module with ports and no body; yosys keeps it as a black box, nextpnr has no cell of that type.
- [design-too-big](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/design-too-big/): nextpnr ran out of a real resource of the chip; the counts are in the log.
- [timing-not-met](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/timing-not-met/): The longest path between two registers is longer than the clock period; the CLI writes no bitstream where Vivado would, with a critical warning.
- [empty-fasm](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/empty-fasm/): The place-and-route output file is empty, usually from a build interrupted between nextpnr and the bitstream.
- [openfpgaloader-failed](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/openfpgaloader-failed/): The board was found, and programming still failed; openFPGALoader's own lines above say why.
- [two-vivado-projects](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/two-vivado-projects/): More than one .xpr file is present, so the CLI cannot choose the intended project.
- [vivado-file-missing](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/vivado-file-missing/): An enabled source or constraint entry names a file that is absent from this checkout.
- [vivado-project-unreadable](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/vivado-project-unreadable/): The project file is not parseable Vivado XML.
- [vivado-path-unknown](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/vivado-path-unknown/): A listed path uses a Vivado variable that this CLI cannot resolve.
- [vivado-set-ambiguous](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/vivado-set-ambiguous/): The project does not identify which of several source, constraint or simulation sets to use.
- [vscode-tasks-unreadable](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/vscode-tasks-unreadable/): The task document or its ownership record cannot be interpreted safely.
- [vscode-tasks-conflict](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/vscode-tasks-conflict/): An existing task label or input id collides with the proposed configuration without verified ownership.
- [vscode-tasks-write-failed](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/vscode-tasks-write-failed/): Writing or replacing the task document or ownership record failed.
- [vscode-not-found](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/vscode-not-found/): The VS Code command is unavailable; the FPGA command-line toolchain can still be used.
- [vscode-extension-install-failed](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/vscode-extension-install-failed/): The companion extension could not be built, installed or verified.
- [vscode-linter-shim-retained](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/vscode-linter-shim-retained/): The companion is retained because a settings value still points to its linter shim, or settings cannot be checked safely.
- [cannot-write-here](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/cannot-write-here/): The build directory is not writable, or the disk has no space for the temporary source copies.
- [command-timeout](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/command-timeout/): The JSON wrapper stopped a command that did not finish within its deadline.
- [internal](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/internal/): Starting the command, reading its output or another wrapper operation failed.
- [mcp-not-installed](https://nosey-dewdrop.github.io/dewfpga/errors/mcp-not-installed/): The isolated MCP Python environment is missing or cannot import the required SDK.
